text:
Maya (Design): quick sync — mock v3 of sidebar grouping + breadcrumb behavior is in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/console-nav-v3. key points: group by 'surface' vs 'workflow', sticky breadcrumb shows lineage, and new 'permalink' for panel states. Need product/eng/accessibility input by Thurs. :eyes:
Sam (Product): looked—nice. question: how do permalinks survive route refactor? we can't break existing external links.
Liam (Eng): agree. we should keep legacy routes as redirects for 6 months. also need to confirm how client handles deep state (panel open, filters).
Maya (Design): plan is to convert routes but keep compat layer. example mapping in mock: 
```text
/project/:pid/workflows -> /workspaces/:pid/flows
/project/:pid/workflows/:wid -> /flows/:wid?project=:pid
```
might be controversial.
Aisha (Accessibility): a11y nits: keyboard focus order on collapsed groups, skip-to-content anchor, aria-current handling for crumb items. breadcrumb separator should be decorative only (aria-hidden). Also permalinks should include focus management so screen readers announce when nav changes. :warning:
Liam (Eng): good catches. for focus we can emit `focus()` after history.pushState but need to ensure no layout shifts. Also prefer `?view=` params to huge path rewrites—easier for server logs.
Sam (Product): rollout idea: feature-flagged client rollout + server-side redirects. canary to 20% orgs for 2 weeks, track 404s and permalink usage.
Maya (Design): updated figma with focus flow and aria notes. added compact vs expanded prototypes. https://figma.com/file/abc123/console-nav-v3?node-id=234:45 :sparkles:
ConsoleBot: design-doc uploaded — /docs/nav-refactor/v3, created by Maya.automations
Aisha (Accessibility): tiny copy nit: crumbs should use 'Back to' in hover for parents — better context for assistive tech.
Liam (Eng): small technical q: when we collapse groups, do ids stay stable? we need stable slugs for permalinks. propose canonical slugs derived from last-updated name.
Maya (Design): yes canonical slugs will be modelled in the metadata. i'll add a note to the doc. also adding migration table for old -> new slugs.
Sam (Product): can someone add telemetry events: nav_click, permalink_open, redirect_404? i'll make a ticket.
Maya (Design): thanks — @Sam can you own telemetry ticket? @Liam can you draft redirect plan? @Aisha will review a11y checklist. target sync Thu 10am. :thumbsup:
Liam (Eng): on it.
Aisha (Accessibility): will review.
Sam (Product): ack.
